scripts.setup: uv sync --dev && cd frontend && pnpm install
scripts.frontend:devtools: cd frontend && pnpm run dev --mode devtools
scripts.dev: pnpm run openapi && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "pnpm run backend" "pnpm run frontend"
scripts.dev:demo: cross-env FM_DATABASE__PATH=data/demo.db FM_BACKUP__DIR=backups/demo FM_SERVER__PORT=8001 pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:devtools: pnpm run openapi && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "pnpm run backend" "pnpm run frontend:devtools"
scripts.check: pnpm run openapi && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run front:check
